tests.fuel_material: CH4/N2 or C2H4/N2 on a porous burner (emulates a burning solid)
tests.note: One row per atmosphere ACME BRE tested, from its final report, not one row per test: the BRE table lists tests by day without pressures. The table also lists 25 % and 40 % oxygen on some days, at pressures it does not give. Conditions: p. 5, “14.7 psia, 21 % oxygen”. Outcome: p. 18, “this extinction was predominately seen for nominal ambient conditions of 21% oxygen and 14.7 psia”.

tests.fuel_material: CH4/N2 or C2H4/N2 on a porous burner (emulates a burning solid)
tests.note: One row per atmosphere ACME BRE tested, from its final report, not one row per test: the BRE table lists tests by day without pressures. The table also lists 25 % and 40 % oxygen on some days, at pressures it does not give. Conditions: p. 5, “10.2 psia, 26.5 %”. Outcome: p. 18, “At conditions of 27% oxygen, 10.2 psia and 34% oxygen, 8.2 psia, the flames generally persisted for 3 minutes or more”. The report writes this atmosphere as 26.5 % on p. 5 and 27 % on p. 18.
